name: outrider
description: Outrider watches GitHub and starts PR review sessions in Kiro Crew. It picks up the activity that needs you — your own PRs, mentions, review replies and PRs you opt into with a reaction — and brings each one into the Crew folder you already review in.
author: appetizers-io

args: from kiro_crew.apps.manager import app_dir; import runpy; runpy.run_path(str(app_dir("outrider") / "backend/mcp_launcher.py"), run_name="__main__")

highlights: Keep up with faster-moving PRs: start reviews automatically when relevant GitHub activity arrives
Put a PR on your radar with 👀, then follow its review in your existing Crew folders
Get reviews that can inspect the code and run focused checks in an isolated checkout
Keep your own PRs moving with sessions that help address review feedback
Make your review process repeatable with workflows tailored to each repository
Stay in control of who reviews, how many sessions run, and which actions need your approval
